wilson_95_ci.methodology_note: Message-level Wilson 95% binomial intervals assume independent Bernoulli trials; consult cluster-level semantic-family bootstrap CIs for correlated uncertainty.

threshold_selection_methodology.threshold_sensitivity_analysis: Exploratory inspection of TPR, FPR, group error concentration, Bayes PPV sensitivity, and illustrative assumed-cost rankings across candidate cutoffs tau in [0.30, 0.95] on internal Dev/Val (N=400) and grouped OOF (N=703).
threshold_selection_methodology.threshold_selection: Inspecting multiple thresholds on OOF predictions and noting any candidate (e.g. tau=0.85) constitutes exploratory selection against that same OOF data; it cannot simultaneously serve as an unbiased confirmation of the chosen cutoff.
threshold_selection_methodology.independent_threshold_validation: Unavailable (UNAVAILABLE_BLOCKED): requires frozen one-shot evaluation on an untouched qualified Class C external holdout, which does not exist.

provisional_candidates.limitation: Identified via exploratory OOF sweep where 0 / 37 curated benign families failed; not independently validated. Under an unmet i.i.d. family assumption, the mathematical 0/37 reference is <= 7.78% one-sided CP / <= 9.41% Wilson (or <= 8.20% under 35 macro-collapsed groups), which is NOT a population bound or message-level carrier FPR.

provenance_and_sampling_audit.family_construction: Closed collection of 56 manually assigned explicit_family archetypes in train_onnx_model.py (96 hand-written base/conversational seeds + 607 programmatic template instantiations).
provenance_and_sampling_audit.cross_family_dependencies: Nominally distinct families share authoring generators (8 US banks span 12 benign/fraud families; 3 two-way bank alert families share one syntax loop; fraud_urgent_brand_alert [35] + fraud_uk_bank_alert [30] form 40.6% of fraud rows; SF-007 phone-damage/P2P vocabulary spans 8-10 families with max_cross_family_centroid_cosine=0.459025).
provenance_and_sampling_audit.cluster_size_skew: Benign sizes range 2..53 (26.5x, top-5=39.8%); fraud sizes range 2..35 (17.5x, top-3=59.4% of fraud rows). Conditional cluster intervals therefore expose finite-corpus template dominance.

inference_boundary_tiers.scope_and_caveat: Intact-cluster resampling preserves within-family correlation and quantifies finite-corpus template dominance conditional on this fixed, hand-authored synthetic family set.

Interpreting bootstrap percentiles or 0/37 binomial limits as family-population bounds requires i.i.d. sampling from a benign/fraud template population—violated by shared banks, keywords, and size skew.

inference_boundary_tiers.tier: 3. Generalization to unseen real-world carrier SMS traffic
inference_boundary_tiers.scope_and_caveat: Requires an independently collected Class C carrier holdout with authentic message-level traffic shares.

cost_evidence_distinction.assumed_mathematical_model: Available across 12 named illustrative scenarios and a 72-ratio normalized factorial grid (576 cells across 8 prevalences).
cost_evidence_distinction.empirically_measured_operational_cost: Unavailable; actual carrier financial/churn costs unmeasured.
cost_evidence_distinction.operational_business_decision: Requires measured carrier costs, prevalence, and Class C validation.

evidence_interpretation_boundaries.permitted_interpretation: Development/validation evidence; not independent holdout evidence
Conditional estimates on 56 curated synthetic families; not i.i.d. carrier traffic or untouched final test set
Conditional cluster-bootstrap sensitivity on curated 56 families (and unverified exchangeable-family reference only); not unconditional population CIs
Conditional mathematical reference assuming 37 i.i.d. benign families (violated in curated corpus); not a population binomial bound or message FPR
Exploratory sensitivity under assumed linear ratios; not measured operational costs, and not independent threshold validation
Modeled prevalence sensitivity; not observed production precision

threshold_and_base_rate_analysis.scope_and_limitations_note: No Class C primary external two-class fraud holdout exists (UNAVAILABLE_BLOCKED per SF-010/SF-011; no N=300 external holdout exists). Internal Dev/Val (N=400) and SF-009 grouped OOF (N=703, G=56 curated synthetic families) provide conditional sensitivity estimates only, not unconditional carrier CIs, population binomial bounds, independent threshold validation, or measured operational costs.

principled_ratio_grid_coverage.structural_note: Spanning the orthogonal quotient space reveals low-prevalence threshold sensitivity (multiple single winners at pi=0.5% and pi=1.0%) masked by smaller handpicked subsets; remaining lock-in of tau_block=0.85 stems mechanically from observed FPR(0.85)=0.0 and zero Tier-2 fraud-reduction term in the linear dual-tier formula.

cost_sensitivity.structural_objective_caveat: compute_dual_tier_cost_per_1000 models only Tier-1 fraud escape and differential Tier-2 FP cost (C_T2 - C_T1) * (1 - pi) * FPR(t2); it assigns zero additional fraud-mitigation benefit to immediate wire blocking over async review, mechanically favoring any threshold with observed FPR=0 such as tau=0.85 whenever FPR(0.85)=0.
cost_sensitivity.limitation: All normalized units are assumed illustrative ratios, not measured euros, customer churn costs, or carrier incident expenses.

grouped_uncertainty.sampling_assumption: Resamples 56 intact semantic_family_id clusters with replacement (B=10000, seed=42) conditional on this fixed curated synthetic collection (excluding replicates missing a class denominator). Empirical caveat: these curated families share generators and are NOT i.i.d. carrier population draws, so 2.5th-97.5th percentiles quantify conditional template-dominance sensitivity (or an unverified exchangeable-family model reference), NOT unconditional confidence intervals for carrier traffic.
grouped_uncertainty.message_level_fpr_limitation: Concentrated false positives across few benign families produce wide conditional cluster sensitivity spans; only independent Class C observations validate carrier FPR.

group_level_zero_event_bound.limitation: Conditional mathematical reference for curated families ONLY, NOT a population-level binomial bound and NOT message-level carrier FPR. grouped_uncertainty.message_level_fpr_limitation: Conventional cluster bootstrap degenerates to [0, 0] with 0 observed false-positive groups; neither population binomial bounds nor message-level carrier FPR intervals can be estimated without independent external observations.
